role: spec §7 build 3 — paired-control + ONLY the re-implemented undeclared-ABox-predicate detector (feature-gated, OFF by default).

reimplementation.vs_prototype: Prototype iterated DECLARED OWLAnnotationProperty signatures filtered by the substring '/property/', deduped by LOCAL NAME, and registered EVERY match as an OBJECT property (OAEI-non-compliant + mistyped).
reimplementation.new_design: Discovers predicates from ACTUAL ABox usage (ANNOTATION_ASSERTION axioms with individual/resource subjects); tallies literal-valued vs resource-valued uses per predicate; classifies literal->DATA property, resource->OBJECT property, mixed->undeclared_abox_mixed_use_policy (default majority_tie_data); keys by COMPLETE IRI; excludes RDF/RDFS/OWL/XSD/metadata built-ins + already-declared properties; deterministic (sorted by IRI); emits an audit. No /property/ substring, no track/filename logic.
files_changed: indexing/OntologyProcessing.java (indexUndeclaredAboxPredicates + classify/exclude/register helpers; invocation after declared property processing)
reimplementation.mixed_use_policy: default 'both' — register an undeclared predicate in EVERY property lane it is actually used in (literal-use->data lane, resource-use->object lane, both->BOTH). This is the correct cross-KG policy: the same logical property is often a resource in one KG and a literal in another, and single-lane typing would split the two sides. Options: majority_tie_data/object, data, object.

verification.byte_inert_conference: PASS — kg-abox (flag ON, both policy) == paired-control on cmt<->Conference (identical alignments); audit correctly absent.

kg_sentinel_memoryalpha_stexpanded.verdict: PASS — meets the §22.3 sentinel (+77 property mappings; property recall 0/41 -> 40/41), achieved with correct usage-based typing rather than the prototype's force-all-object.
kg_sentinel_memoryalpha_stexpanded.diagnosis_of_first_attempt: majority-vote policy first gave 29/41; all 41 predicates were discovered but 11 genuinely mixed-use predicates (e.g. father: memoryalpha 5 lit/263 res vs stexpanded 227 lit/186 res) were split into opposite lanes. The 'both' policy registers mixed predicates in both lanes, recovering all 11.

verification.known_artifact: 'both' emits symmetric-mixed pairs in both lanes (raw_property_lines=120 vs 77 distinct). Harmless for URI-pair evaluation (deduped); but the M_ask/bridging path (Python) must dedupe property mappings by URI pair before oracle consultation to avoid double-asking a mixed predicate. Tracked for P4/P8.
